predecessors.name: Federal Republic of Somalia
predecessors.text: the Bari, Nugaal and Mudug regions of north-eastern Somalia; the page says only the northern part of Mudug is Puntland's ('the southern part of Mudug is part of Galmudug')

ledger.x: 1998: the dispute with Somaliland over Sool, Sanaag and Ayn begins.

wars.name: Sool and Sanaag dispute with Somaliland
wars.outcome: Somaliland took Las Anod in October 2007; the dispute over Sanaag continues and SSC-Khatumo took Las Anod from Somaliland in 2023.

certainty.note: Borders with Somaliland, Galmudug and the Khatumo administration are fronts and clan lines, not surveyed; the page calls the southern half of Mudug disputed ('citation needed').
